name: Pyramids Apt. 4
headline: Jacuzzi Studio By The Historic Pyramids (Apt.4)
summary: Step into Pyramids Apartments, where ancient wonders meet modern comfort, Start your day with pyramid views from your window, and end it soaking in your own private in-room jacuzzi.

description.Space:
This bright and cozy apartment is designed for relaxation and comfort, perfect after a full day exploring the pyramids and the lively streets of Giza.
Inside, you’ll find:

✔️ A private indoor jacuzzi, thoroughly cleaned and sanitized before every stay
✔️ One Queen-sized bed with hotel-quality Egyptian cotton linens
✔️ A bathroom stocked with fresh face and body towels
✔️ A compact kitchenette for light meal preparation
✔️ Free Wi-Fi, Cable TV, and Chromecast
✔️ A Nespresso machine
✔️ Complimentary bottled water and two coffee capsules
description.Access:
✔️Guests will have full private access to the Apartment and all of its amenities during their stay.
✔️For larger groups or multiple bookings, feel free to contact us — we may have additional units available in the same building or nearby.

⚠️Please note that occasional water or electricity outages may also occur due to local infrastructure maintenance. These are usually resolved quickly, we appreciate your understanding.

While the photos of the room are accurate, the building and surrounding area are in extremely poor condition. Although it would appear that the hosts are trying to make the best out of a bad situation (the building is unfinished in multiple areas, as are many buildings in Cairo), it is a bit misleading to present this property as an exclusive retreat or anything remotely close to luxurious, when the elevator is missing basic safety elements (namely a door that closes once the elevator is in motion).

I arranged airport pick-up, however ws made to wait 30 minutes while my driver waited for another fare. I was not told that I would be sharing transportation. The host provided a 10% discount on my stay for this inconvenience, as well as consideration that I would be traveling for a couple of days (while still paying for the listing).

I was also locked in when trying to leave to catch a flight at 3:30 am. A woman from an apartment within the building unlocked the door to let me out of the building. Freedom of movement is a basic human right (at least in the United States). There is no explanation to explain why I was locked in, why it was no communicated that the entry/exit would be locked, and why I did not have access to unlock said door.

My flight took me to Luxor for more sight-seeing. I chose to pay for the additional days that I would be gone rather than lug my luggage around. Upon return, I asked the gentleman who watched the place (who was also very kind) whether my keys worked to unlock the front door. He attempted to use the keys that I was given and confirmed that they did not work to unlock the door. He said that he would be awake for my 5 am departure the next day (which he was). He also assisted me with catching a taxi, in addition to helping with the luggage. Again, this gentleman (whose name unfortunately escapes me) was very helpful throughout. I believe that he was the security person for the building.

I think honest reviews are important, particularly to individuals traveling to an entirely different region. The place unfortunately does not feel safe. Again, the views and room photos are accurate. However, nothing else about the location matches the listing. Also, you may be prevented from exiting at certain times of the day. I will be seeking remedies from AirBnB via legal recourse available, as they endorse and condone the state of the listing.

L’appartement n’était pas propre (moisissures dans la douche ainsi qu’au niveau du jacuzzi) beaucoup de poussières et de taches (murs, sol, draps etc) 
Pour finir, nous n’avons pas eu d’eau dans l’appartement pendant une soirée, une nuit et une matinée donc impossible de se doucher, utiliser les toilettes ou encore moins ce fameux jacuzzi pourtant compris dans ce prix.

Très déçus par le rapport qualité prix et la propreté de ce logement, malheureusement nous ne le recommandons pas.
